How to Use the Data Extractor

Welcome to the Estimates Engine!

This tool automates the extraction of key financial data (Target Prices, Ratings, EPS, Sales, etc.) from various broker research reports (PDFs) directly into structured Excel formats.

1 Select the Broker Report

Go to the "Extract Data" tab. Click the dropdown to choose which broker report template you want to use (EGR, MNCS, RBC, TAS, etc.).

2 Upload the PDF File

Drag & drop your PDF file onto the page or click to browse files. You can also paste a direct URL link if the report is hosted online.

3 Start Processing

Click Start Processing and wait for the engine to read the PDF. Once complete, you will be able to download a perfectly structured Excel output.
